Lemma
[Injectivity radius and compact thick part] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0209 1. ch31:31.41\group Margulis lemma

The injectivity radius on the $\varepsilon $-thick part is at least $\varepsilon /2$. In a finite-volume hyperbolic manifold the thick part is compact.
